Elise now has its own repository, installer, release versions, and service manager.

- Install with root `install.sh`; manage nodes with `elisectl` and use `elise` for the Rust CLI.
- Release archives include matching management/migration tools and SHA-256 checksums for Linux amd64 and arm64.
- Migrate existing nodes with `elisectl migrate --from-v2bx --dry-run`, then `elisectl migrate --from-v2bx`.
- Migration preserves certificates, service states, supported customizations, and live traffic-state paths. Failures attempt rollback.
- Updates restore previous program files and services if startup checks fail. Uninstall keeps configuration and state.
- Hysteria 2 interoperability uses an independent pinned Go module; V2bX is not required to build or test Elise.

This release carries the Elise 1.0.3 protocol implementation and vendored TLS/QUIC patches forward. Running instances briefly disconnect clients during update or migration. Keep legacy configuration directories because migrated nodes retain their existing traffic-state paths.

See the [v1.0.4 README](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise/blob/v1.0.4/README.md#installation) and [v1.0.4 migration/recovery guide](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise/blob/v1.0.4/docs/migration.md). These migration instructions describe v1.0.4; current releases no longer include automatic migration.
